items.title: 7.5 Hypothesis testing ke liye data visualisation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Data visualization (data ko chart aur graph ki shakal mein dikhana) hypothesis testing mein aham kirdar ada karti hai, kyunke yeh data ko wazeh aur samajh aane wali shakal mein pesh karti hai. Is se researchers statistical tests lagane se pehle data mein patterns (naqsh), trends (rujhan) aur rishte dekh lete hain. Tasveeri shaklein pecheeda data samajhna aasan aur nataij ki ghalat-fehmi ka imkaan kam karti hain. Charts aur graphs se groups ke farq aasani se milaye ja sakte hain (Figure 7.2). Visualization datasets mein outliers (baqi se bohat door qeematein) aur anomalies (ajeeb qeematein) pehchanne mein bhi madad deti hai, aur tasveeri saboot de kar behtar faisle karwati hai. Mukhtasar yeh ke data visualization wazahat aur durusti barha kar hypothesis testing ko mazboot banati hai.

blocks.alt: 2 x 2 khanon mein chaar charts: Bar Chart (Value 0 se 100) jis mein neeli Control Group patti aur oonchi narangi Treatment Group patti, dono par error bar; Line Graph, Time ke muqable Value, lines Prediction A aur Prediction B; pie chart (daira) 40%, 15%, 20% aur 25%; aur scatter plot, Variable 1 ke muqable Variable 2, neele Group A aur narangi Group B ke nuqte, dashed charhti line, aur do daire wale nuqte jin par Outlier likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: Data visualization (kitab ki Figure 7.2 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bar chart: Control Group taqreeban 63 aur Treatment Group taqreeban 77. Line graph: neeli Prediction A barabar oopar jati hai; narangi Prediction B ahista charhti hai aur us mein do kaale nuqton wala hamwar hissa hai. Scatter plot: Variable 2 0 se 2 tak; Group A ke nuqte dashed line ke baen aur Group B ke daen taraf hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is figure mein chaar charts hain. Bar chart do groups (control aur treatment) ki average value ka muqabla karta hai; patti par lagi line (error bar) batati hai ke values kitni upar neeche hoti hain. Line graph waqt ke saath Prediction A aur B ki tabdeeli dikhata hai. Pie chart aik daire ko hisson mein baant kar har hisse ka feesad (percentage) dikhata hai: 40% + 25% + 20% + 15% = 100%. Scatter plot do variables ka rishta dikhata hai; jo nuqta baqi nuqton se door ho, woh outlier hai.

Data visualization is liye zaroori hai ke yeh kache (raw) data ko ba-maani tasveeri shaklon mein badal deti hai. Is se researchers bare datasets jaldi samajh lete hain jinhein sirf numbers se samajhna mushkil hota. Visual tools data ke trends, distributions (phailao) aur farq wazeh dikhate hain, aur nataij ko technical aur non-technical dono qism ke logon tak pohanchana aasan banate hain. Ghair-mamooli patterns nazar aane se ghaltiyan bhi kam hoti hain. Yeh statistics ke nataij ko behtar samajhne mein madad deti hai, is liye data analysis aur hypothesis testing mein yeh zaroori qadam hai.
Nataij pesh karne ke graphs aur charts

Hypothesis testing ke nataij pesh karne ke liye graphs aur charts aam tools hain. Bar charts categories ya groups ka muqabla karne ke liye achhe hain. Line graphs waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeliyan dikhate hain. Pie charts hisse (proportions) aur feesad (percentages) dikhate hain. Scatter plots do variables ka rishta dikhate hain. Yeh tools nataij ko zyada dilchasp, wazeh aur samajhne mein aasan banate hain (Figure 7.2).
Data visuals ko hypotheses se jorna

Data visuals nataij ko seedha hypothesis se jorte hain. In se researchers aankh se dekh sakte hain ke data hypothesis ko support karta hai ya reject. Maslan ek comparison graph control group aur experimental treatment group ka farq dikha sakta hai. Line graph ke trends mutawaqqa nataij ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain. Scatter plots hypothesis mein bataye gaye rishte pehchanne mein madad dete hain. Tasveeri saboot hypothesis testing mein mantiqi soch ko mazboot karta hai, is liye data visualization hypothesis ko sahi ya ghalat sabit karne mein bari madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa chart behtareen dikhayega ke treatment group ke average number control group se zyada the, aur phir bhi test kyun karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Do groups ke means ka bar chart. Chart farq dikhata hai, lekin sirf hypothesis test batata hai ke farq ittifaq se bara hai ya nahi.

items: Visualization testing se pehle aur baad patterns, farq aur outliers dikhati hai.
Bar: groups ka muqabla; line: waqt ke saath trend; pie: hisse; scatter: do variables ka rishta.
Charts faisle ko support karte hain magar test ki jagah nahi lete.
